top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information-Emergency Contact (26 TAC §744.605(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 3 children need emergency contact information for child admission form.

top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements - Daily Menu, Including All Snacks and Meals Prepared or Served (26 TAC §744.401(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Menu was not posted during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §744.1205(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it has been determined that child was left unattended, and caregiver was not at a physical proximity which did not allow visual and/or auditory awareness of the child in care.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records (26 TAC §746.801(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Playground check sheets were not available.

top_violation_types.title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Labeled for Each Toddler (26 TAC §746.2505(4)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Bottles in the toddler's room were not labeled with children's names.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Preventing and Responding to Abuse and Neglect (26 TAC §746.501(a)(26))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies did not include all the required information for abuse and neglect.
